time_contracts.conversion: MITL interval unit is seconds; runtime seconds use identity conversion.

monitor_contract.exact_rescaling: All finite seconds bounds are multiplied exactly by 1000 into integer milliseconds; no rounding or epsilon is introduced.
monitor_contract.finite_word_semantics: Reference oracle: complete pointwise finite word. TAMonitor: infinite-word prefix. Both adapters use monotonically increasing absolute synthetic global-clock ticks, not inter-event delays. The two verdict domains are stored separately; unsupported executions and mismatches are not replaced by oracle verdicts.

positive.mutation: positive_after_threshold: Response occurs strictly after the lower threshold and no response occurs before it. TAMonitor prefix expectation=INCONCLUSIVE; comparison=PASS.

boundary_first_grid_point_legal: An open dense-time lower boundary has no least legal instant; T+1 ms is an exact grid witness, not epsilon. TAMonitor prefix expectation=INCONCLUSIVE; comparison=PASS.

boundary_negative.mutation: boundary_exact_excluded: The response is prohibited through the closed threshold and the eventual interval is open at that threshold. TAMonitor prefix expectation=NEGATIVE; comparison=PASS.
too_early_one_tick: Response occurs one exact monitor tick before the threshold. TAMonitor prefix expectation=NEGATIVE; comparison=PASS.

late_or_missing.mutation: late_response_unbounded_legal: The source formula has no finite upper response bound; a late response is legal, not a violation. TAMonitor prefix expectation=INCONCLUSIVE; comparison=PASS.
missing_completed_trace: The independent oracle treats this synthetic finite word as complete and no required response occurs. TAMonitor prefix expectation=INCONCLUSIVE; comparison=PASS.
